founder_input.product_idea: A tool that automatically reconciles GST invoices against purchase orders for mid-size Indian manufacturing companies, flagging mismatches before month-end filing.
founder_input.vision: Become the default GST compliance layer that every mid-size Indian manufacturer runs its finance operations through.
assumptions: Finance teams at mid-size manufacturers still reconcile GST invoices manually or in spreadsheets
Compliance teams will pay for a tool that reduces month-end filing errors and penalties
founder_input.founder_knowledge: Spent 6 years running finance operations at a mid-size auto-parts manufacturer in Pune and personally dealt with GST reconciliation pain every month.

phase1_output.problem_statement: Mid-size manufacturing companies in India struggle with inaccurate and labor-intensive GST invoice reconciliation against purchase orders, leading to potential compliance errors, financial penalties, and inefficient month-end closures.
initial_hypotheses: Mid-size manufacturing companies in India have a significant pain point around GST invoice reconciliation, which affects their compliance accuracy and leads to financial penalties.
Finance teams in these companies currently rely on manual processes or spreadsheets for GST reconciliation, resulting in significant inefficiencies and errors.
These companies are willing to pay for a tool that reduces the time and errors associated with month-end GST filing, as this directly impacts their financial reporting efficiency.
The tool's ability to automatically flag mismatches and suggest resolutions significantly reduces time spent by finance teams on reconciliation tasks.
The market size of mid-size Indian manufacturers facing this issue is large enough to sustain a profitable business.
success_criteria: In initial outreach, at least 30% of targeted finance managers express frustration with current GST reconciliation processes and interest in a streamlined solution.
Early pilot users report at least a 50% reduction in time spent on GST reconciliations after implementing the tool.
At least 20 mid-size manufacturing companies adopt the tool within the first year, showing a strong willingness to pay for the solution.
Feedback from initial users indicates that mismatch flagging and resolution suggestions are accurate and significantly aid in their month-end processes.
The tool achieves integration partnerships with at least 2 major ERP providers within the first 18 months, ensuring wide accessibility and reduced implementation friction.
